sports.palette_bias: energetic contrast with clean subject separation
extra_rules: sport equipment must be anatomically and logically correct
prefer decisive action over posed portrait
preserve scale and physical challenge
avoid generic landscape dominance

food.palette_bias: appetising warmth with premium highlight contrast
extra_rules: food texture must be readable
avoid sterile menu photography
show journey or discovery, not just scenery

music.palette_bias: emotional stage or intimate ambient lighting
extra_rules: instrument or performance act must be obvious

gaming.palette_bias: warm social atmosphere with readable game surface
extra_rules: interaction between people matters as much as game objects
show process, tools, and hands where useful

technology.palette_bias: cool modern base with controlled warm human accents
extra_rules: avoid generic cyberpunk
show purposeful interaction
medium or experience must be unmistakable

wellness.palette_bias: soft restrained tones with clean light
extra_rules: specific activity anchor required
keep hobby identity stronger than scenery

learning.palette_bias: warm intellectual atmosphere with clear human curiosity
extra_rules: show the act of learning, examining, reading, discussing, or discovering rather than an abstract symbol
avoid classroom-stock imagery unless the interest specifically requires it

lifestyle.palette_bias: warm contemporary lifestyle color with inviting social depth
extra_rules: show a believable lived experience or social ritual
avoid generic influencer or stock-lifestyle posing

pets.palette_bias: warm natural tones with expressive human-animal connection
extra_rules: animal species and care/activity cues must be coherent
avoid costume-like anthropomorphism or unsafe handling

career.palette_bias: polished real-world professional light with human warmth
extra_rules: show profession-specific work, tools, environment, or collaboration
avoid generic laptop-office imagery when a field has distinctive cues

transport.palette_bias: cinematic machine detail with strong route or motion context
extra_rules: keep vehicles generic and unbranded
show use, journey, maintenance, or enthusiast context rather than showroom advertising

science.palette_bias: clean exploratory light with tactile real-world scientific detail
extra_rules: show observation, fieldwork, experiment, specimen, instrument, or evidence
avoid meaningless glowing science graphics

collecting.palette_bias: curated warm display light with tactile object detail
extra_rules: show curation, ownership, comparison, or careful handling
avoid random piles and marketplace catalogue shots
